बॉलीवुड के नए क्रश वीर हिरानी अब एक बिल्कुल नए अंदाज में अपने फैंस का दिल जीतने आ रहे हैं! 🎬

'Pritam & Pedro' में अपने काम से तारीफें बटोरने वाले एक्टर वीर हिरानी अब वॉइस एक्टिंग में कदम रखने जा रहे हैं।

रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, वह 'The Jungle Book' से प्रेरित एक अपकमिंग AI-generated इंडियन फीचर फिल्म में Mowgli के किरदार को अपनी आवाज देंगे। इस हिंदी वॉइस ट्रैक वाली फिल्म को Sripal Morakhia प्रोड्यूस और Soumitra Ranade डायरेक्ट कर रहे हैं।

हाल ही में Avinash Arun की सीरीज में Pritam Parker का रोल निभाकर दर्शकों के बीच 'national crush' बने वीर की यूनीक आवाज को भी काफी पसंद किया गया। इसी वजह से उन्हें डबिंग, एनिमेशन प्रोजेक्ट्स और ASMR रिकॉर्डिंग्स के भी कई ऑफर्स मिले थे। 🎙️

अब इस नए प्रोजेक्ट के साथ वीर हिरानी अपनी आवाज और एक्सप्रेशन्स के जरिए Mowgli के इस मशहूर काल्पनिक किरदार में एक नया आयाम जोड़ेंगे। 🌟

क्या आप वीर हिरानी को Mowgli की आवाज बनते सुनने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर दें! 👇

ctx.text:
Vir Hirani is set to explore a new aspect of his career as he ventures into voice acting. The actor will lend his voice to Mowgli in an upcoming AI-generated Indian feature film inspired by The Jungle Book . The film is being produced by Sripal Morakhia and directed by Soumitra Ranade, with a Hindi voice track.
The project comes after Vir's streaming debut as Pritam Parker in Avinash Arun's Pritam & Pedro , which also stars Arshad Warsi and Vikrant Massey. His performance in the series has received a positive response from viewers, with many expressing their appreciation for his work and referring to him as the 'national crush'.
Apart from his on-screen presence, Vir's voice has also drawn attention. His distinctive voice has reportedly led to several offers for voice-over and dubbing assignments, including projects in animation. He has also received requests for voice notes and ASMR recordings.
With the upcoming film, Vir will take on the character of Mowgli, bringing his interpretation to the familiar fictional character through voice, expressions and characterisation. The project will give him an opportunity to explore a different form of performance and add another dimension to his work.
His association with the film also comes at a time when more Indian actors are exploring voice acting for animated projects. For Vir, the upcoming feature marks another step in his career following the response to Pritam & Pedro .
